description: This source file defines the code-behind for the 'Leaderboard' web page in an online examination system, handling page load event, session validation, and navigation button events.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard page, managing lifecycle events and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, checks user session, fetches user's semester info from database, and stores it in session; redirects to login if session is invalid.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to Dashboard page when home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to UserProfile page when profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for Leaderboard button click (currently no implementation).

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by resetting session and redirects to login page.
